headline: Tongi drug gang held Dhaka Tribune journalists hostage and tortured them
summary: The journalists were reportedly tortured at gunpoint by a criminal gang operating in Tongi, Gazipur.
details: Journalists from the Dhaka Tribune were held hostage and tortured at gunpoint by a drug gang operating in Tongi.
The victims were targeted up close, facing violence and threats of death at the gunpoint of the gang members.
The incident highlights the risks journalists face while reporting on crime and drug trafficking in the areas of Gazipur.
The Dhaka Tribune has condemned the attack on its staff, emphasizing the safety of the press during their professional duties.

headline_marked: [[School bus set on fire]] in Dhaka’s Bhatara
headline: School bus set on fire in Dhaka’s Bhatara
summary: Firefighters brought the blaze under control on the 100-foot road in the Bhatara area on Sunday afternoon.
details: A school bus was set on fire on the 100-foot road in the Bhatara area of the capital on Sunday afternoon.
The incident occurred around 5:15 PM, causing significant damage to the vehicle.
Fire service personnel arrived at the scene shortly after and managed to bring the blaze under control.
Debashish Roy, a duty officer of Bhatara Police Station, stated that the Officer-in-Charge (OC) and other police members visited the spot upon receiving the news.
Authorities have not yet confirmed the exact cause of the fire.
